decisions.statement: A warmup raises the temperature, mobilises the muscles, then ramps the movement.
Alan is warm where a set of his falls inside the window handed in.
An Alan already warm is owed the ramp alone, the raise having been paid.
A movement ramped inside the window is owed no warmup at all.
A set stating no instant leaves Alan cold, whatever day that set falls on.
A movement mobilises where its pattern is mobility and its force is not static.
The movements offered are those sharing a muscle with the movement to come.
No held stretch is offered before a working set.
Whether a movement moves through a range is read from force rather than stated.
The raise names one cardio movement rather than leaving what to do open.
A raise Alan's kit cannot carry is no raise to offer.
A raise sharing a muscle with the work to come leads; where none does, every raise is drawn on.
The raise Alan performed longest ago is the raise offered.
The day parts raises Alan has gone equally long without.
What Alan raised with is read from the sets he logged as cardio.
A raise Alan performs without logging it ages no further, so the day alone varies it.

definition: what Alan does before a working set, and whether he is warm already
